# Code of conduct

## Our standards

Contributors and maintainers are expected to communicate respectfully,
criticize ideas rather than people, give mathematical and technical claims a
clear evidentiary basis, and welcome corrections made in good faith.

Harassment, discriminatory language, personal attacks, deliberate
misrepresentation, and publication of another person's private information
are not acceptable.

## Scope and enforcement

This policy applies in repository issues, pull requests, reviews, discussions,
and other project spaces. Maintainers may edit or remove contributions and
temporarily or permanently restrict participation when behavior violates
these standards.

Report conduct concerns privately to the repository owner using a contact
method published on the `sairmath` GitHub profile. Reports will be reviewed
promptly and handled with as much confidentiality as practical.

This project code of conduct is adapted from the principles of the
[Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
